placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
The Lake Grounds offer a gentle mix of green space and waterside views. Watch the birds on the lake, pause at the children's play equipment and enjoy the open lawns with a packed lunch.

Our family idea: make one easy circuit your starting plan, with time to stop whenever something catches a child's eye. A short visit works well here; you can add a coastal wander if everyone still has energy.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Picnics, bird spotting and an easy-going outdoor afternoon.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Children's play equipment, open lawns and sports facilities.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Follow signs for the Lake Grounds and check local parking restrictions on arrival.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Keep children close at the water's edge. The neighbouring outdoor pool is a separate attraction with its own tickets and season.
